text: You were rude this afternoon. I put it down to nerves. Nerves don't come back at eleven at night.
style: CEO and former conference speaker, late forties. Speak with a consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Smooth, low-to-mid pitch; unhurried, polished pace. Cool, precise and amused; never raises her voice, because she has never needed to.
